_comment: Two records from two once-only top-level literals in one array; the program provides boxes[0] as an unrelated Config service and passes boxes[1], holding only a string, to a Schedule whose callback calls the method of a captured service the string names. The named method stays and the bundle runs. Guards that a record that may be a provided value still names a method. The unread one is not checked: Schedule.fromStep's step is a callback handed to type-modelled code and runs with unknown arguments, so the computed read through its input is an unknown key and keeps every method (accepted imprecision; the pass no longer steps a Schedule). (Before the deletion it guarded that the Schedule input filter dropped only definite services; that filter is gone.)
